mapper.select: SELECT * FROM script_clue WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO script_clue (script_id, stage_id, title, content, visibility_type, visible_character_id, event_time, location, credibility, is_key_clue, is_misleading, sort_order) VALUES (#{scriptId}, #{stageId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{visibilityType}, #{visibleCharacterId}, #{eventTime}, #{location}, #{credibility}, #{isKeyClue}, #{isMisleading}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE script_clue SET stage_id = #{stageId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, visibility_type = #{visibilityType}, visible_character_id = #{visibleCharacterId}, event_time = #{eventTime}, location = #{location}, credibility = #{credibility}, is_key_clue = #{isKeyClue}, is_misleading = #{isMisleading}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
